title: Illinois crypto tax is impossible to enforce as written, crypto industry tells court
content: The legal battle to head off the crypto transaction tax in Illinois has drawn up a hefty roster of industry opposition, and they're saying the tax won't work.

title: DTCC adds Solana to Wall Street tokenization plans, targeting 2027 rollout
content: The securities infrastructure giant plans to bring tokenized stocks, ETFs and U.S. Treasuries to Solana as it expands next year's roadmap beyond Stellar and Arc.

title: Bitcoin slides toward $71K as Nvidia stock tumbles after Huang steps down
content: Bitcoin fell to its lowest leve since Aug. 20 as tech stocks slid following the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO, exits board; shares plunge
content: Colette Kress will remain Nvidia’s chief financial officer while serving as interim CEO as the board searches for a permanent successor.

title: Bit Digital stock falls 5% in pre-market after Q3 revenue miss
content: Bit Digital’s $27 million third-quarter revenue came in 16% below analyst consensus estimates, marking an over $5 million shortfall.

title: Thailand proposes $148K daily cap on stablecoin deposits and withdrawals
content: Thailand’s SEC would set separate daily caps for stablecoin deposits and withdrawals and require customers to use wallets they own.

title: Crypto hack losses equal 57 cents per $1 earned onchain: Ark’s Valente
content: Crypto hackers stole $8.7 billion so far in 2026, surpassing the projected annual onchain revenue generated across the industry, according to ARK’s research director.

title: Tron, Tether and Chainalysis Form a New Crypto-Crime Task Force—Replacing One That Just Collapsed
content: The Digital Crime Task Force aims to proactively trace illicit USDT on Tron and freeze funds before they move—just weeks after the trio’s near-identical T3 unit, built with rival firm TRM Labs, quietly collapsed.

title: Anchorage Digital’s Stablecoins Can Now Settle Payments on Visa’s Network
content: Visa and eligible companies can now use Western Union’s USDPT—issued and custodied by the federally chartered Anchorage Digital Bank—to settle VisaNet obligations.

title: Tether Gold Gets Clean KPMG Audit Confirming $2.2B in Physical Gold Backing
content: KPMG counted every gold bar behind XAUT, making it Tether's second stablecoin to complete a full audit by a Big Four accounting firm.

title: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO, With CFO Colette Kress Named Interim Chief
content: The Nvidia co-founder steps down after reports of affairs with an alleged Chinese spy and a company executive, ending his 33-year run.

title: SoFi Brings Its Bank-Issued Stablecoin to Polygon’s Payments Stack
content: SoFiUSD, the first stablecoin from a U.S. national bank, is now live on Polygon Open Money Stack alongside Ethereum and Solana.

title: Israel Discount Bank to Let Customers Trade Bitcoin in App Starting Nov. 26
content: Bitcoin Magazine Israel Discount Bank to Let Customers Trade Bitcoin in App Starting Nov. 26 Eligible customers 18 and older can buy, hold and sell bitcoin and ether from Nov. 26, with Fireblocks custody and a six-month fee waiver. This post Israel Discount Bank to Let Customers Trade Bitcoin in App Starting Nov. 26 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: JPMorgan Lifts Its Strategy (MSTR) Stake 36% and Holds $540 Million in Bitcoin ETFs
content: Bitcoin Magazine JPMorgan Lifts Its Strategy (MSTR) Stake 36% and Holds $540 Million in Bitcoin ETFs A 13F filed Thursday shows JPMorgan held 848,932 Strategy shares, up 36% from June, and 11.4 million IBIT shares worth $540 million at Sept. 30, weeks before MSCI's index exit. This post JPMorgan Lifts Its Strategy (MSTR) Stake 36% and Holds $540 Million in Bitcoin ETFs first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Crypto Exchange Gemini Sells U.K. and EU Units to KAST for Under $10 Million
content: Bitcoin Magazine Crypto Exchange Gemini Sells U.K. and EU Units to KAST for Under $10 Million A person familiar with the matter said Gemini sold its already shuttered U.K. and European operations to Singapore payments firm KAST for less than $10 million, hours before the exchange reports third-quarter results. Gemini declined to comment. This post Crypto Exchange Gemini Sells U.K. and EU Units to KAST for Under $10 Million first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Geopolitical Strategist: Bitcoin Is the “Third Way” Between the Dollar and Yuan
content: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Geopolitical Strategist: Bitcoin Is the “Third Way” Between the Dollar and Yuan Velina Tchakarova, geopolitical strategist and founder of FACE (For A Conscious Experience), argues that we're in a new Cold War and that the US and China are building two rival financial architectures. This post Geopolitical Strategist: Bitcoin Is the “Third Way” Between the Dollar and Yuan first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .

title: BNY Mellon Raises Its Strive (ASST) Stake 28% to $7 Million as Monday’s 13F Deadline Nears
content: Bitcoin Magazine BNY Mellon Raises Its Strive (ASST) Stake 28% to $7 Million as Monday’s 13F Deadline Nears A Nov. 5 13F shows Bank of New York Mellon held 237,100 Strive shares worth $6.97 million at Sept. 30, up 51,544 shares from June, with other large filers still due Monday. This post BNY Mellon Raises Its Strive (ASST) Stake 28% to $7 Million as Monday’s 13F Deadline Nears first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
